routes.label: AC_extract

material.name: A. capillaris water extract (freeze-dried powder, 0.1 % w/v stock solution)

routes.method: sonication-assisted water extraction of Artemisia capillaris aerial part, freeze-drying
routes.quote: The extraction process was then performed by sonication for 3 h.

reagents.name: Artemisia capillaris aerial part (pulverized powder)
reagents.supplier_quote: A. capillaris was purchased from Ominherb (Uiseong-gun, Gyeongsangbuk-do, Republic of Korea).
reagents.quote: A. capillaris was pulverized, and the pulverized powder was mixed with deionized water in a ratio of 10:90 (the pulverized powder: deionized water, v/v).

reagents.name: deionized water (extraction and stock preparation)
reagents.quote: A. capillaris was pulverized, and the pulverized powder was mixed with deionized water in a ratio of 10:90 (the pulverized powder: deionized water, v/v).

steps.description: Pulverize the aerial part of A. capillaris.
Mix the pulverized powder with deionized water at a powder:water ratio of 10:90 (v/v).
steps.quote: the pulverized powder was mixed with deionized water in a ratio of 10:90 (the pulverized powder: deionized water, v/v)

parameters.name: volume_ratio
parameters.quote: in a ratio of 10:90 (the pulverized powder: deionized water, v/v)

steps.description: Extraction by sonication; the supernatant is pooled and the extraction step repeated three times.
steps.quote: The extraction process was then performed by sonication for 3 h.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.quote: The extraction process was then performed by sonication for 3 h.

parameters.name: repetitions
parameters.value_text: This step was repeated three times
parameters.quote: After sonication, the supernatant was pooled. This step was repeated three times.

steps.quote: After sonication, the supernatant was pooled.

steps.description: Filter the pooled supernatant on filter paper.
steps.quote: The pooled supernatant was filtered using filter paper.

equipment.quote: The pooled supernatant was filtered using filter paper.

steps.quote: The filtrate was then freeze-dried and stored at −80 °C in a freezer.

equipment.detail: FD8518 (IlShinBioBase Co. Ltd., Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea)
equipment.quote: A FD8518 freeze dryer was used to prepare powdered samples (IlShinBioBase Co. Ltd., Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea).

steps.description: Store the freeze-dried powder in a freezer.
steps.quote: The filtrate was then freeze-dried and stored at −80 °C in a freezer.

steps.description: Dissolve the freeze-dried powder in deionized water to prepare the extract stock solution.
steps.quote: To prepare the extract stock solution, the freeze-dried powder was dissolved in deionized water.
Then, centrifugation (UNION 55R) was conducted at 22 °C (30 min, 7,546g).

equipment.detail: UNION 55R (Hanil Science Industrial Co. Ltd., Incheon, Republic of Korea)
equipment.quote: Centrifugation was performed using either a 5424R (Eppendorf AG, Hamburg, Germany) or UNION 55R (Hanil Science Industrial Co. Ltd., Incheon, Republic of Korea).

steps.description: Take the supernatant and filter it on a 0.45 μm syringe filter.
steps.quote: The supernatant was taken and syringe-filtered (0.45 μm).

parameters.name: pore_size
parameters.quote: The supernatant was taken and syringe-filtered (0.45 μm).

equipment.quote: Syringe filters (0.45 μm) were purchased from Sartorius Stedim Biotech (Goettingen, Germany).

steps.description: Freeze-dry the filtrate again; the powder is labeled A. capillaris water extract.
steps.quote: The filtrate was freeze-dried, and the freeze-dried powder was labeled “A. capillaris water extract”

steps.description: Redissolve the freeze-dried extract in deionized water to a final concentration of 0.1 % (w/v) (stock solution for the AuNP synthesis and the phytochemical screening).
steps.quote: the freeze-dried powder was labeled “A. capillaris water extract” and dissolved in deionized water to a final concentration of 0.1 % (w/v)

parameters.name: concentration
parameters.quote: dissolved in deionized water to a final concentration of 0.1 % (w/v)

characterizations.result: saponins, amino acids, phenolic compounds, flavonoids and diterpenes present; the other tests negative
characterizations.conditions: procedures of references CR18 and CR19 (not reproduced in the article)
characterizations.quote: As shown in Table 1, saponins, amino acids, phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and diterpenes were present in the extract.

characterizations.instrument: Varian 640IR (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA, USA)
characterizations.conditions: attenuated total reflectance mode
characterizations.quote: The FT-IR spectrum of the extract shows peaks at 3268, 2917, 1592, 1402, 1257, 1051, and 669 cm−1

outcomes.property: phytochemical_test: Phenolic compounds — Ferric chloride test
phytochemical_test: Anthraquinone glycosides — Modified Borntrager’s test

missing_fields: mass or volume of plant powder

routes.label: AC-AuNPs-0.015

material.name: gold nanoparticles synthesized with A. capillaris water extract (AC-AuNPs)

characterizations.result: SPR maximum at 543 nm; violet solution
characterizations.instrument: Shimadzu UV-2600 (Shimadzu Corporation, Kyoto, Japan), quartz cuvette
characterizations.conditions: 400 to 700 nm
characterizations.quote: The SPR values of AC-AuNPs at each extract concentration were as follows: 543 nm (0.015 %), 537 nm (0.025 %), 535 nm (0.035 %), 534 nm (0.045 %), and 534 nm (0.055 %).

characterizations.result: mostly spherical; average size 29.93 ± 9.80 nm (100 particles measured)
characterizations.instrument: JEM-2100F microscope (JEOL Ltd., Tokyo, Japan)
characterizations.conditions: 200 kV; carbon-coated copper grid (carbon type B, 300 mesh, Ted Pella Inc.), dried for 24 h at ambient temperature
characterizations.quote: The average size of the AC-AuNPs was measured to be 29.93 ± 9.80 nm for 0.015 %, 26.60 ± 7.93 nm for 0.025 %, 21.49 ± 6.90 nm for 0.035 %, 20.77 ± 7.07 nm for 0.045 %, and 16.88 ± 5.47 nm for 0.055 %.

characterizations.instrument: NanoBrook 90Plus Zeta (Brookhaven Instruments Corporation, Holtsville, NY, USA)
characterizations.conditions: each sample measured ten times and the values averaged
characterizations.quote: AC-AuNPs | Hydrodynamic size (nm) (polydispersity index) | 26.9 (0.358) | 29.0 (0.353) | 33.9 (0.328) | 37.1 (0.308) | 41.3 (0.286)

characterizations.instrument: NanoBrook 90Plus Zeta (Brookhaven Instruments Corporation, Holtsville, NY, USA)
characterizations.conditions: each sample measured five times and the values averaged

characterizations.result: reaction completed in 3000 s; rate constant 1.07 ×10-3 s−1
characterizations.instrument: Shimadzu UV-2600 (Shimadzu Corporation, Kyoto, Japan), quartz cuvette
characterizations.conditions: 4-NP 0.4 mM (1 mL) + sodium borohydride 40 mM (1 mL) in a 4 mL quartz cuvette, 100 μL of catalyst, final volume 4 mL with deionized water; progress monitored every 5 min between 200 and 500 nm at 25 °C
characterizations.quote: 4-NP (0.4 mM, 1 mL) and sodium borohydride (40 mM, 1 mL) were mixed in a 4 mL quartz cuvette. Then, 100 μL of either AC-AuNPs or cf-AC-AuNPs was added, and the final volume was adjusted to 4 mL with deionized water. Upon the addition of AuNP catalysts, the reaction progress was monitored every 5 min by UV-visible spectrophotometry between 200 and 500 nm range at 25 °C.

outcomes.quote: The synthesized AC-AuNPs were mostly spherical, as shown in Fig. 4.
The SPR values of AC-AuNPs at each extract concentration were as follows: 543 nm (0.015 %), 537 nm (0.025 %), 535 nm (0.035 %), 534 nm (0.045 %), and 534 nm (0.055 %).
the color of the AC-AuNPs solution was violet (0.015 %) or wine (0.025~0.055 %) which was dependent on the extract concentration (Fig. 2a)

The average size of the AC-AuNPs was measured to be 29.93 ± 9.80 nm for 0.015 %, 26.60 ± 7.93 nm for 0.025 %, 21.49 ± 6.90 nm for 0.035 %, 20.77 ± 7.07 nm for 0.045 %, and 16.88 ± 5.47 nm for 0.055 %.

The average size of the AC-AuNPs was measured to be 29.93 ± 9.80 nm for 0.015 %, 26.60 ± 7.93 nm for 0.025 %, 21.49 ± 6.90 nm for 0.035 %, 20.77 ± 7.07 nm for 0.045 %, and 16.88 ± 5.47 nm for 0.055 %.

The numbers of nanoparticles selected from the TEM images were as follows: 100 nanoparticles for 0.015 %, 102 nanoparticles for 0.025 %, 101 nanoparticles for 0.035 %, 106 nanoparticles for 0.045 %, and 104 nanoparticles for 0.055 %.
The times required for reaction completion were as follows: 3000 s for 0.015 %, 2700 s for 0.025 %, 2400 s for 0.035 %, 2100 s for 0.045 %, and 1800 s for 0.055 %.

routes.method: green synthesis: reduction of HAuCl4 by A. capillaris water extract, incubation at 80 °C
routes.quote: A. capillaris water extract was used as a reducing agent to synthesize AuNPs (hereafter referred to as AC-AuNPs).

reagents.name: hydrochloroauric acid trihydrate
reagents.supplier_quote: Hydrochloroauric acid trihydrate (HAuCl4·3H2O), 4-nitrophenol, and sodium borohydride were purchased from Sigma-Aldrich (St. Louis, MO, USA).
reagents.quote: For the synthesis of AC-AuNPs, the final concentration of hydrochloroauric acid trihydrate was fixed at 0.25 mM.

reagents.name: A. capillaris water extract (route AC_extract)
reagents.quote: The extract concentration was varied at 0.015, 0.025, 0.035, 0.045, and 0.055 %.

reagents.name: deionized water
reagents.quote: The final volume was adjusted to 4 mL by adding deionized water.

steps.description: Mix the HAuCl4 stock solution (1 mM) and the extract stock solution (0.1 %) and adjust with deionized water to a final volume of 4 mL (final HAuCl4 0.25 mM).
steps.quote: The final volume was adjusted to 4 mL by adding deionized water.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.quote: The final volume was adjusted to 4 mL by adding deionized water.

steps.description: Incubate the mixture in a dry oven at 80 °C for 1 h.
steps.quote: The incubation was conducted at 80 °C in a dry oven for 1 h.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.quote: The incubation was conducted at 80 °C in a dry oven for 1 h.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.quote: The incubation was conducted at 80 °C in a dry oven for 1 h.

equipment.quote: The incubation was conducted at 80 °C in a dry oven for 1 h.

annotations.text: L'article prépare des nanoparticules d'or par réduction de HAuCl4 à 80 °C avec un extrait aqueux d'Artemisia capillaris, à cinq concentrations d'extrait (0,015 à 0,055 %). Les particules sont caractérisées (SPR, MET, DLS, potentiel zêta, DRX, IR) puis testées comme catalyseurs de la réduction du 4-nitrophénol par NaBH4. L'extrait est ensuite retiré par centrifugation (cf-AC-AuNPs), ce qui augmente la constante de vitesse jusqu'à 50,4 %.
annotations.quote: The average size of the AC-AuNPs decreased as the extract concentration during the synthesis was increased.

annotations.text: Les auteurs veulent savoir comment la concentration d'extrait végétal pendant la synthèse règle la taille des nanoparticules d'or et leur activité catalytique, et si l'extrait restant à la surface des particules aide ou gêne la catalyse.

Un seul paramètre de synthèse est balayé : la concentration finale d'extrait (0,015, 0,025, 0,035, 0,045 et 0,055 %) à concentration d'or fixée (0,25 mM). Le but est de relier la quantité de réducteur et de stabilisant à la taille des particules, puis la taille à la vitesse de réduction du 4-nitrophénol. La centrifugation de chaque lot sert de second jeu de comparaison, à extrait retiré.

Quand la concentration d'extrait passe de 0,015 à 0,055 %, la taille MET moyenne diminue de 29,93 à 16,88 nm, la bande SPR se décale de 543 à 534 nm, la taille hydrodynamique augmente de 26,9 à 41,3 nm et la constante de vitesse du 4-NP passe de 1,07 à 1,73 ×10-3 s-1. Après centrifugation, les constantes valent 1,44 à 2,21 ×10-3 s-1, soit +27,7 à +50,4 %, et le temps de réaction passe de 3000-1800 s à 2100-1500 s (lu sur la Fig. 8).
annotations.quote: Under all extract concentrations, the rate constants of cf-AC-AuNPs (1.44 × 10−3~2.21 × 10−3 s−1) were higher than those of AC-AuNPs (1.07 × 10−3~1.73 × 10−3 s−1).

annotations.text: Plus la concentration d'extrait est élevée, plus les particules d'or sont petites et plus la réaction catalysée est rapide ; les auteurs expliquent la baisse de taille par un rôle de coiffant des composés organiques de l'extrait.
annotations.quote: As the extract concentration was increased, the average size of the AC-AuNPs decreased.

annotations.text: Pour les trois concentrations les plus élevées (0,035, 0,045 et 0,055 %), la couleur vin des cf-AC-AuNPs ne change pas et la bande SPR vers 600~650 nm tend à disparaître après centrifugation, alors qu'à 0,015 et 0,025 % le spectre s'élargit et un nouveau signal apparaît vers 600~650 nm, signe de particules polydisperses.
annotations.quote: When the extract concentration was increased from 0.035 to 0.055 %, the SPR at 600~650 nm tended to disappear.

annotations.text: Le premier recyclage des cf-AC-AuNPs reste actif mais avec des constantes bien plus basses (0,038 à 1,75 ×10-3 s-1) ; au deuxième recyclage la réaction ne se produit plus. La valeur du potentiel zêta ne croît pas de façon strictement monotone avec la concentration d'extrait pour les AC-AuNPs (−20,92 mV à 0,045 % contre −20,63 mV à 0,055 %), contrairement à ce que dit le texte.
annotations.quote: An attempt was made for the reuse of cf-AC-AuNPs on the second recycle; however, the catalytic reaction did not proceed any further.

annotations.text: Les auteurs concluent que la taille du cœur métallique commande l'activité catalytique et que retirer l'extrait par simple centrifugation améliore la constante de vitesse, méthode qu'ils jugent transposable à d'autres nanoparticules synthétisées avec des extraits de plantes.
annotations.quote: Thus, the current method, which uses simple centrifugation, can be applied to other metallic nanoparticles that are green-synthesized with plant extracts to enhance their catalytic activity in the 4-NP reduction reaction.

annotations.text: Les auteurs attribuent la réduction de Au(III) aux flavonoïdes, aux composés phénoliques et aux acides aminés de l'extrait, d'après le criblage phytochimique et l'IR, et proposent que les composés organiques servent de coiffants qui limitent la croissance.
annotations.quote: Collectively, the phytochemical screening and FT-IR results suggest that the flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and amino acids present in the extract are mostly likely involved in the reduction of Au ions and/or are complexed (or adsorbed) on the surface of AC-AuNPs.

annotations.text: Probablement, les groupes phénoliques et énoliques des flavonoïdes réduisent AuCl4− en Au(0) à 80 °C, avec oxydation en quinones ; les germes d'or sont ensuite stabilisés par adsorption des polyphénols, des protéines et des saponines de l'extrait. Plus la concentration d'extrait est grande, plus il y a de germes et de coiffant, d'où des particules plus petites. Cette lecture est une hypothèse de chimiste et ne vient pas de l'article.

L'acide chloroaurique est corrosif et irritant ; le borohydrure de sodium est inflammable, dégage de l'hydrogène au contact de l'eau et est toxique ; le 4-nitrophénol est toxique par contact et ingestion. Le congélateur à −80 °C expose à des brûlures par le froid, l'étuve à 80 °C à des brûlures thermiques, et la centrifugation à 18 000 g impose un équilibrage correct des tubes. L'article ne mentionne aucune précaution. Les déchets contenant de l'or et du 4-nitrophénol doivent être collectés séparément.

Les volumes des solutions mères d'or et d'extrait, l'ordre d'ajout, l'agitation éventuelle, le récipient d'incubation et le rendement ne sont pas donnés. La masse ou le volume de poudre de plante est seulement exprimé en rapport 10:90 (v/v), la pureté de HAuCl4 et du solvant est absente, et les procédures du criblage phytochimique sont renvoyées à deux références. Le nombre exact d'extractions (« repeated three times ») et les conditions de lyophilisation (température, durée, pression) ne sont pas précisés. Les nanoparticules ne sont pas isolées : elles sont utilisées en suspension avec l'extrait.

Figures lues : Fig. 8 (temps d'achèvement de la réaction des cf-AC-AuNPs, valeurs écrites sur les flèches de la figure). Fig. 3b (spectres UV-visible des cf-AC-AuNPs), Fig. 5 (DRX), Fig. 7 (spectres d'avancement), Fig. 9 (ln(Ct/C0) en fonction du temps) n'ont pas été relevées point par point : leurs résultats chiffrés sont donnés par le texte ou les tableaux. L'article n'a pas d'annexe.

method_sources.quote: The other tests were performed according to the procedures described in reference
The detailed procedures of the following six tests are described in reference

doubts.issue: « This step was repeated three times » : lu comme répétition de l'extraction par sonication de 3 h, mais l'article ne dit pas si le nombre total d'extractions est 3 ou 4. Lecture la plus littérale retenue (value_text).
La quantité de poudre de plante n'est donnée que par le rapport « 10:90 (the pulverized powder: deionized water, v/v) » : aucune masse ni volume absolu. Recopié tel quel en amount_text.
La concentration d'extrait (0,015 à 0,055 %) est écrite « % » sans préciser w/v dans la phrase de synthèse, alors que la solution mère est « 0.1 % (w/v) » ; unité « % » recopiée.
Les valeurs 0.038 ×10-3 (deux fois), 0.39 ×10-3 et 0.75 ×10-3 sont recopiées telles qu'écrites ; l'écart de 0.038 à 0.39 pourrait être une faute de frappe des auteurs mais rien ne permet de trancher.

Valeurs lues sur la Fig. 8 (a 2100 s, b à d 1800 s, e 1500 s) : ce sont les durées imprimées sur les flèches de chaque panneau, donc exactes à la lecture. Le texte dit seulement que le temps est plus court que pour les AC-AuNPs. Figures non quantifiées : 3b, 7, 9.
